description: This PHP source file defines the class AesEncryptingStream, which implements an encrypting data stream using AES encryption, compatible with the AWS SDK. It provides methods for reading encrypted data, seeking within the stream, and retrieving encryption parameters.
external_methods: CipherMethod's getOpenSslName, getAesName, getCurrentIv, requiresPadding, seek, update

classes.name: AesEncryptingStream
classes.description: A class representing an AES-encrypted stream of data, providing encrypted reading and stream management features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the encrypted stream with a plaintext stream, encryption key, and cipher method.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher name used by the cipher method.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Retrieves the current initialization vector used for encryption.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total size of the encrypted stream, considering padding if necessary.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that this stream is not writable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the encrypted stream, encrypting data from the underlying plaintext stream as needed.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Adjusts the current position within the stream, resetting buffer and seeking underlying streams accordingly.

methods.name: encryptBlock
methods.description: Encrypts a block of plaintext data read from the underlying stream, applying OpenSSL encryption.
